articles.title: Hyperliquid eyes 55% price rise after Silicon Valley investor's 'massive HYPE buy'
articles.snippet: A bullish long-term chart pattern puts HYPE on track for a potential rally above $70 this year, with a16z-linked accumulation and fresh institutional catalysts strengthening the case.

articles.title: Kraken cuts 150 staff amid AI efficiencies, potentially delaying IPO: Report
articles.snippet: Kraken has cut 150 staff due to the rising use of AI, adding to more than 5,000 layoffs across the crypto sector so far this year, Bloomberg reports.

articles.title: Grayscale, VanEck amend US spot BNB ETF filings, stepping closer to potential launch
articles.snippet: The US securities regulator approved 21Shares’ Hyperliquid ETF last week, adding to a growing number of cryptocurrencies converted into ETF wrappers in the US.

articles.title: Packs of Empty Waymos Are Weirding Out Atlanta Neighborhood
articles.snippet: Residents in northwest Atlanta say empty Waymo robotaxis have spent weeks repeatedly circling residential streets early in the morning.
